claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Witness could not read any brand or model text on the console in either photo; shape alone does not confirm PS5 Slim identity.
No legible brand/model markings found on console in photo 0 or photo 1; white curved-panel shape is consistent with several consoles, not uniquely confirmed.
Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show a white and black controller resting against the console.
Only side and front views shown; back, top, and underside not visible, so scratches/dents cannot be ruled out.

risks.risk: Console may not be the claimed brand/model (PS5 Slim) since no logo or model number is legible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console's logo, model number sticker, or rear port layout
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unconfirmed home console, not as a verified branded PS5 Slim

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or boot correctly
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on and reaching the home/dashboard screen

risks.risk: Missing essential accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, charging cable for pad)
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as console and single pad only, no cables

risks.risk: Hidden damage on unseen sides (back, top, underside, disk drive slot)
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides plus close-up of disk slot and ports
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible cosmetic/port damage, worst case

risks.risk: Storage capacity and software state unknown, could affect usability
risks.proof: Photo of system settings/storage screen or boot-up menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as base/unknown storage, no premium for capacity

risks.risk: Controller condition and functionality (stick drift, battery health) unknown
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller connected and analog sticks moving without drift
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested controller, possible defect risk

proof_requests: Close-up photo of console logo/model number and rear port panel
Video of console powering on to home screen
Photo of all included accessories (cables, extra controllers, games)
Photos of top, back, and underside of console
Short video of controller sticks/buttons being tested
response.reason: The witness confirms a home console with a controller, but no brand or model is legible, so the PS5 Slim claim and cleanliness are unverified; price at generic/unconfirmed console worst case until proof is supplied.
